environment.laravel_app_scope: minimal API app; default global middleware; no database/auth/providers beyond framework auto-discovery

limitations: closed-loop client; host-shared CPU; frameworks tested sequentially, Orku first per session
each session measures 5 batches per concurrency; combined summary has 10 per cell
raw batches include every measured observation; P95/P99 summary is median of batch percentiles, not pooled percentile
container CPU/RAM include app process and probes; batch CPU counter spans request batch plus probe overhead
image tags pinned by local image IDs in this report; timing and results are machine-specific
